errors.description: Request body is not valid JSON.
Input does not match the tool's declared input schema.
The requested tool does not exist on this server.
X-PAYMENT header is not valid base64-encoded JSON or does not match the expected payload shape.
The EIP-3009 signature does not recover to the 'from' address in the voucher.
The voucher value does not match the current tool price. Re-fetch the 402 challenge for the live quote.
The voucher 'to' address does not match the server's declared recipient.
The voucher's validBefore timestamp is in the past. Re-fetch the 402 challenge for a fresh window.
The voucher's validAfter timestamp is in the future.
The voucher nonce has already been used. Generate a fresh nonce and re-sign.
The facilitator submitted the transfer on-chain but it reverted (e.g., insufficient balance). Re-fetch the challenge and retry with a funded wallet.
The facilitator is unreachable or returned a server error. This is transient — retry with backoff.
Mainnet settlement requires a facilitator URL, which is not configured on this deployment.
The upstream RPC or external API used by this tool is unreachable. The call was not charged — retry later.
A required secret or environment variable is not set on this deployment.
Too many requests. Retry after the backoff period.
An unexpected server error occurred. This is a bug — please report it.
